FROM A WORD TO A WORLD

Believable places.
Room for your imagination.

Our mission is to create 3D procedural worlds that are believable and parametric, so users can experiment with style, size, motif and purpose.

01 · NOW

Understand a bedroom

A bed needs a wall and access. Storage needs opening space. Daylight gives a desk a reason to be somewhere. Change the room and those relationships adapt.

02 · NEXT

Give the sketch volume

Use this same blueprint for a low-poly 3D room, with simple materials, warm light and an orbiting camera.

03 · THEN

Let it acquire character

Study real rooms, refine the design rules, and introduce curated assets. “Add whimsy” becomes a change in shapes, relationships and details.

A GROWING DESIGN VOCABULARY

What this bedroom knows.

These are explicit prototype rules, not a learned model or a building-code assessment. We can revise them through studies and actual room critiques.

Sleep is the anchor

Try bed positions against three walls. Reserve space beside the bed and at its foot before choosing other furniture.

Movement comes before decoration

Keep the door swing open. Check a walkable route from the entrance to each placed furniture item.

Objects have reasons

Favor daylight for the desk. Put a side table beside the bed. Give the wardrobe space to open.

Small rooms make tradeoffs

Keep the bed first, then storage. If requested furniture cannot fit, say so instead of squeezing it into a path.

Motif lives on top of function

Autumn colors, bedside pumpkins, botanical accents and party garlands change the dressing while keeping the route clear.

THE NEXT CHAPTER

The same room.
One more dimension.

This first version is deliberately 2D. Its exported blueprint records the room, openings, furniture sizes, placement, access zones and decoration anchors.

Low-poly volume

Extrude walls, add furniture proxies and a simple playful shader. Keep the same corner and direction controls.

Real decoration

Replace proxies with fitted artwork. Check the room from the doorway, beside the bed and at eye level.

Learn from studies

Collect examples and corrections into versioned rules. The generator grows in specificity as we critique it together.
